\begin{example} \end{example}[Eikonal equation] ↗ def:complete-integral 1. ch3:3.1-ex-2\group Nonlinear First-Order PDE

For $|Du|=1$, a complete integral is \[ u(x,a,b)=a\cdot x+b,qquad a\in S^{n-1},\ b\in \R . \] \end{example}
